mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an active monetary easing policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines month-over-month, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that suppress consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 4.0%, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous month-over-month declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal a broad-based consumer demand contraction that triggers equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline month-over-month, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In an early-stage recession (INDPRO decline and UNRATE > 4.0%), a federal funds rate cut signals policy support that stabilizes economic activity, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In early-stage recession periods (INDPRO decline and UNRATE > 4.0%), SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in total nonfarm employment (PAYEMS) signals strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases month-over-month, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1400.0 thousand units indicate a contraction in residential construction activity that reduces economic momentum, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 1400.0, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous month-over-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and negative quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signal a deepening economic slowdown that triggers equity market corrections, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO declines and GDPC1 growth is negative, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion with high inflation (UNRATE < 4.0% and CPIAUCSL > 2.5%), a month-over-month increase in CPI signals impending monetary tightening, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion with high inflation (UNRATE < 4.0% and CPIAUCSL > 2.5%), SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL increases month-over-month, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.
